📐 GARCH(1,1) Volatility Forecasting

core/econometric_features.py

Models time-varying volatility clustering and fat-tailed shocks using Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE):

Conditional Variance:
σ_t² = ω + α·ε_{t-1}² + β·σ_{t-1}²
Stationarity & Persistence:
Persistence: λ = α + β < 1.0
Unconditional Long-Run Variance:
σ_L² = ω / (1 - (α + β))
k-Step Ahead Mean-Reverting Forecast:
σ_{t+k}² = σ_L² + (α + β)^{k-1} · (σ_{t+1}² - σ_L²)
Trading Impact: Widens stop-loss distances and contracts position size when volatility persistence λ > 0.95 to protect equity from regime expansion.

⚖️ Dynamic Kalman Filter StatArb

core/kalman_statarb.py

Online recursive state-space cointegration estimation tracking dynamic hedge ratios:

State & Observation Equations:
θ_t = [α_t, β_t]^T = θ_{t-1} + w_t
y_t = α_t + β_t·x_t + e_t
Kalman Gain & Innovation:
e_t = y_t - (α_{t|t-1} + β_{t|t-1}·x_t)
K_t = P_{t|t-1} F_t^T / (F_t P_{t|t-1} F_t^T + V_t)
Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Half-Life:
τ_{1/2} = -ln(2) / θ
Execution Rules: Long Spread at Z < -2.0, Short Spread at Z > +2.0, Exit Target at |Z| ≤ 0.20, Invalidation Stop at |Z| ≥ 3.0, Time Stop at 2·τ_{1/2}.

🎯 Avellaneda-Stoikov Scalping

core/avellaneda_stoikov.py

Microstructure high-frequency inventory risk and reservation price modeling:

Reservation Price r(s, q, t):
r(s, q, t) = s - q·γ·σ²·(T - t)
Optimal Half-Spread δ*:
δ* = (1/2)·γ·σ²·(T - t) + (1/γ)·ln(1 + γ/κ)
Quote Bracket:
p_bid = r - δ*, p_ask = r + δ*
Inventory Skew: If inventory q > 0 (long), the reservation price shifts downward below mid-price, quoting more aggressively on ask to shed exposure without taking adverse selection.

⚡ Bayesian Changepoints (BOCPD)

core/bocpd.py

Recursive run-length probability updating to detect instant regime shifts:

Run Length Posterior P(r_t | x_{1:t}):
P(r_t, x_{1:t}) = ∑ P(r_t | r_{t-1}) · P(x_t | r_{t-1}, x_t^(r)) · P(r_{t-1}, x_{1:t-1})
Hazard Function H(r):
H(r) = 1 / λ_hazard (Constant Hazard Prior)
Reaction Time: Detects sudden volatility explosions or trend breaks in 1–3 bars, triggering immediate spread adjustment before indicators lag.

🧠 Laya System 1 Non-Autoregressive Triage

Implemented in data/news_triage.py & research/decision_models/laya_model.py. Runs an in-place streaming ModernBERT-large forward pass with 0 output tokens generated for instant classification:

D0_1 Source Credibility:

Classifies source into TRUSTED_OFFICIAL, VERIFIED_OUTLET, UNVERIFIED_SOCIAL, or SPOOF_REJECTED. Spoofs and unverified social items are permanently blocked from execution graph.

D0_3 Fact vs. Opinion:

Strips commentary and speculation, passing only hard quantitative prints (CPI, NFP, rate hikes, official statements) into research memory.

D9 Emergency Kill Switch:

Identifies acute geopolitical war outbreak or bank failure, immediately halting new order placement.

📈 Multi-Regime Execution Styles

1. Microstructure Scalping SCALP_MAGIC (460002)

Avellaneda-Stoikov inventory skew, order book delta imbalances. Max holding duration 15-30 mins enforced by time stops.

2. Macro & Swing Trend Following SWING_MAGIC (460001)

Multi-day holding driven by BOCPD structural shifts, yield curve steepening/flattening, and COT extreme reversal entries.

3. Crypto & FX Statistical Arbitrage STATARB_ENGINE

Cointegrated asset pairs (BTC/ETH, EURUSD/USDCHF) with dynamic Kalman hedge ratio beta and Ornstein-Uhlenbeck decay exits.

4. Liquidity Hunting & News Avoidance LIQUIDITY_SWEEP

Blackout windows 15 mins before/after Tier-1 news. Fades stop runs above swing highs and below swing lows.

💰 Equity Compounding & Ruin Governance

Managed in core/account_sizing.py & operations/account_growth.py:

Minimum Viable Account (MVA) Sizing:

Ensures micro-accounts ($100-$1000) never breach broker minimum lot sizes or margin call thresholds, preventing forced liquidation.

Fractional Kelly Compounding Ladder:

Scales position lot sizes proportional to realized win rate and payoff ratio, bounded by 0.25% (L2) and 1.0% (L3) maximum risk per trade.

Drawdown Throttling & Ruin Bounds:

Monte Carlo path evaluation cuts risk in half if drawdown exceeds 5%, and flattens all exposure if daily loss exceeds 3%.
